cause_quote: `chatRunState.retireSource(clientRunId, source)` retires the streamed copy when the commentary is saved, and `flushBufferedChatDeltaIfNeeded(...)` then sends the shortened stream to the UI.
user_saw: Progress text briefly appeared in Control UI and then vanished while the agent was still running tools, even as the output-token counter kept rising.
summary: The fix lets Control UI use the producer run ID in transcript metadata to display saved progress messages during an active run.
reasoning: The causing diff added Gateway stream retirement on transcript persistence, while its exact parent already had the UI check that rejected active-run commentary whose producer ID appeared only in transcript metadata. The fix PR reports that the same visibility test passed on that parent and failed on the causing commit, and the fix's test diff confirms that real tool-use events carry the run ID only in transcript metadata.
